texto: Working with Joseba changed the way we discharge patients at the clinic. He never improvises: when he says a patient is ready, he brings the data to prove it.
After surgery I thought I would never get back to the same level. Joseba explained every phase and why we had to wait. I came back better than I was before the injury.
I refer patients to Joseba with complete confidence. He respects biological timelines and does not give in to pressure to rush, which is exactly what a surgeon needs on the other side.
I had trained for years without touching a weight, afraid of losing my lightness. With him I set a personal best in the 1500 m and my tendon pain disappeared.
He fits into the coaching staff without making noise, and he speaks the coach’s language, not only the lab’s. That is the difference from other conditioning coaches.
